21.A.805 Identification of critical parts 
Regulation (EU) No 748/2012 
In addition to the requirement of point 21.A.804, each manufacturer of a part to be fitted on a type-
certificated product which has been identified as a critical part shall permanently and legibly mark 
that part with a part number and a serial number.
